import json,re
from pathlib import Path
initial=Path('analysis/initial.json').read_bytes()
final=Path('analysis/final.json').read_bytes()
prefix=initial[:initial.rindex(b'\n  ]\n}')]
assert final.startswith(prefix+b',\n')
lines=Path('gobreaker.go').read_text().splitlines()
a=json.loads(final); s=json.loads(Path('analysis/supplement.json').read_text())
probe=Path('analysis/_postprobe/identity_test.go').read_text()
names=set(re.findall(r'^func (TestIdentity\w+)\(',probe,re.M))
new=[f for f in a['findings'] if f['id'].startswith('N')]
assert [f['id'] for f in new]==[f'N{i:02}' for i in range(1,6)]
for row in new+s['qualifications']:
 c=row['citation']; assert c['fragment']==lines[c['line']-1]
assert {row['test'] for row in s['test_bindings']}==names
for file in ('draft-verify.json','final-jev.json','final-checks.json','overlay-final.json','review.md','summary.md'):
 assert Path('analysis',file).stat().st_size>0
print('Original row bytes, full-line anchors, probe bindings and deliverables verified.')
